summary: CEIR-17 sec-45/46/47 ceir.scene: the SCENE / query / resource RESOLVER semantics. The host scene→drawlist pipeline (REN-37 material/technique stack + the scene_renderer variant ladder + the frame_runtime draw build) resolves, per draw, its material → technique → program → geometry into GPU handles BEFORE scene.raster records. This dialect gives that resolution its declared CEIR IDENTITY: the four scene.resolve_* ops are NATIVE INTRINSICS (ADR-0110 [op.native] provider=host — the replaceable convenience tier: a user MAY write a different resolver as a CEIR program) that the host implements behind the ADR-0106 #3 IFrameGraphHost seam (CEIR-17b extends the crd-ceir-gpu RenderResolvers callback family; crd-ceir core NEVER links gpu-context — I3/I4). ⛔ CURRENCY RULE (the band's spine): the ECS extract stays HOST; CEIR sees OPAQUE handles/ids ONLY, never ECS types — draw / material / technique / program / geometry are 8a Extern TYPE-CLASSES (the attachment precedent: the ROLE rides the TYPE, so resolve_technique's operand is material-typed and the chain is verifier-checkable), each a DISTINCT TypeId. ⛔ NOT Pure: the resolvers read MUTABLE host + scene state (RAF-11 hot-reload can swap the resolved program mid-session; a scene edit changes the material/geometry assignment) — each op carries the NARROWEST HONEST read effect (SceneRead for the scene-assigned material/geometry, HostStateRead for the hot-reloadable technique/program registries) so no CEIR-26 pass may CSE/hoist a resolve across a reload/scene-edit boundary. Determinism is ExternalNondeterminism (deterministic given the current host state, but that state changes externally). Well-formedness rides the module-walk verifier Context::find_scene_misuse (the find_render_misuse house pattern): each resolve op's operands are the RIGHT scene type-class (draw / material / technique), phase is in its closed vocabulary. ⛔ NO-FOLLOW (named, never silently subset): the query → DrawList bridge (the [[draw_list]] semantics) → CEIR-17c; GPU cull + indirect → CEIR-17d; skinned palette-compute orchestration → CEIR-17e; the RenderResolvers host-callback family that IMPLEMENTS these intrinsics → CEIR-17b (this slice is DECLARE-only: types + ops + verifier + tests).

ops.name: resolve_geometry
ops.summary: Resolve a draw's geometry handle (host intrinsic; reads the scene geometry assignment).
ops.docs: scene.resolve_geometry(%draw) -> %geometry. A HOST intrinsic: resolves the draw's vertex/index geometry handle (SceneRead -- the scene geometry assignment; NOT Pure). find_scene_misuse: operand(0) is scene.draw-typed.

operands.name: draw
operands.doc: the opaque scene draw-item handle (a scene.draw-typed value)

results.name: geometry
results.doc: the resolved geometry handle (an 8a Extern value of the scene.geometry class -- kept OPAQUE; CEIR-17c decides how it feeds the draw expansion)

ops.name: resolve_material
ops.summary: Resolve a draw's assigned material handle (host intrinsic; reads the scene material assignment).
ops.docs: scene.resolve_material(%draw) -> %material. A HOST intrinsic (ADR-0110): resolves the draw's assigned material handle through the REN-37 material stack at record. Reads the scene material assignment (SceneRead) -- NOT Pure. find_scene_misuse: operand(0) is scene.draw-typed.

operands.name: draw
operands.doc: the opaque scene draw-item handle (a scene.draw-typed value)

results.name: material
results.doc: the resolved material handle (an 8a Extern value of the scene.material class); feeds scene.resolve_technique

ops.name: resolve_program
ops.summary: Resolve the raster program for a technique + draw variant (host intrinsic; reads the hot-reloadable program registry + the draw variant).
ops.docs: scene.resolve_program(%technique, %draw) -> %program. A HOST intrinsic: resolves the raster program for the technique + the draw's variant flags through the REN-37 variant ladder (technique->program registry HostStateRead + the draw variant SceneRead; hot-reloadable, so NOT Pure). find_scene_misuse: operand(0) is scene.technique-typed; operand(1) is scene.draw-typed.

operands.name: technique
operands.doc: the technique handle (a scene.technique-typed value from scene.resolve_technique)

operands.name: draw
operands.doc: the opaque scene draw-item handle -- carries the variant flags (skinned/textured/shadowed) that select the program from the ladder

results.name: program
results.doc: the resolved raster program handle (an 8a Extern value of the scene.program class); the per-item program the scene draw records with

ops.name: resolve_technique
ops.summary: Resolve a material's technique handle for a render phase (host intrinsic; reads the hot-reloadable technique registry).
ops.docs: scene.resolve_technique(%material) {phase} -> %technique. A HOST intrinsic: resolves the material's technique for the render `phase` through the REN-37 technique registry (HostStateRead -- hot-reloadable, so NOT Pure and NOT hot_reload_safe). find_scene_misuse: operand(0) is scene.material-typed; phase in its closed vocabulary.

operands.name: material
operands.doc: the material handle (a scene.material-typed value from scene.resolve_material)

results.name: technique
results.doc: the resolved technique handle (an 8a Extern value of the scene.technique class); feeds scene.resolve_program

attributes.name: phase
attributes.doc: the render PHASE the technique is resolved for: opaque | transparent | shadow | depth | velocity. CLOSED vocabulary, find_scene_misuse enforces it. A PLAN-CONSTANT (attr, not operand) -- the phase is fixed per pass.
